parameters.query:
-- Top-3 approved, not-yet-notified matches per user in this batch, aggregated into one row per user.
SELECT u.user_id, u.email,
       json_agg(json_build_object('name', p.product_name, 'provider', p.provider, 'rate', p.interest_rate,
                                  'min_income', p.min_monthly_income, 'reason', m.llm_reason)
                ORDER BY m.rank) AS products,
       array_agg(m.match_id ORDER BY m.rank) AS match_ids
FROM matches m
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = m.product_id
WHERE m.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.status = 'approved' AND m.rank <= 3 AND NOT m.notified
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email
ORDER BY u.user_id;
UPDATE matches SET notified = true WHERE match_id = ANY($1::bigint[]) RETURNING match_id;

UPDATE upload_batches SET status = 'notified', notified_at = now(), emails_sent = (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM matches WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid AND notified) WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid RETURNING batch_id;

parameters.content:
**Workflow C - Notification**

Triggered by workflow B.
1. One row per user with their top-3 products.
2. Build HTML email. Recipient = test alias (never the CSV address).
3. Send via AWS SES node.
4. Mark matches notified, set batch status = notified.
